payload.title: stability_budget reads judgment_drain_per_night through judgment_pipeline_policy(), a key that is not in JUDGMENT_PIPELINE_DEFAULTS, the shipped default JSON or aria-config, with an accessor call that never loads the operator override, so the drain is always 0.0 and the stability re-ask and canary lanes hold every night
evidence: aria-kernel/aria_kernel/stability_reask.py:60-62 (DRAIN_POLICY_KEY is judgment_drain_per_night, documented as read and never re-measured here)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/stability_reask.py:90-101 (budget = policy().get(key) or 0.0 with no repo_root; zero returns held:drain_0.0)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/genesis_policy.py:223-234 (with repo_root None only the shipped default file is read, and only keys of the defaults survive the update)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/data/genesis_policy_default.json:120-123 (the shipped judgment_pipeline block holds max_pending_per_role and sample_size_per_tool only)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/judgment_funnel.py:273-296 (the funnel measures the drain itself with measure_drain_capacity and never publishes it under the key)
aria-kernel/aria_kernel/mutation_canary.py:357-372 (the canary mint takes its budget from the same stability_budget)
aria-kernel/tests/test_stability_reask.py:118-120 (a test pins stability_budget(base_dir) == (0, 'held:drain_0.0') as the production behaviour)
payload.rule_violated: WP-J: the stability and canary lanes' cadence is an explicit function of the MEASURED drain (stability_reask.py:84-89), and the drain has one measurement owner (request_drain_capacity.measure_drain_capacity).
payload.notes: Every nightly outcome_calibration phase calls mint_stability_reasks_for_all_tools and mint_canary_judgments; both take their budget from stability_budget, which reads a policy key no file and no code ever sets, so the budget is 0 and both return held:drain_0.0. The flip table stays empty and the anchor_instability bar in promotion never fires. Setting the key in aria-config would not help: the accessor is called without repo_root and the merge drops keys outside JUDGMENT_PIPELINE_DEFAULTS. Close condition: Have stability_budget derive the drain through request_drain_capacity.measure_drain_capacity (the owner judgment_funnel._tonight_allowance uses) instead of a policy key, and make judgment_pipeline_policy refuse an operator key outside JUDGMENT_PIPELINE_DEFAULTS by name. Test: a result ledger with drained requests inside the window gives stability_budget a positive budget and mint_stability_reasks mints a re-ask (red today); an override naming an unknown judgment_pipeline key raises. Plan row: none named by the audit (audit top fix 3 of segment 2). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
